interpretation: Processed order-level dataset row count.
recommended_action: Use as baseline for order-level percentages.

interpretation: Processed seller-order dataset row count.
recommended_action: Use as baseline for seller-order checks.

interpretation: Duplicate order_id values in processed order-level table.
recommended_action: No action required.

interpretation: Duplicate seller_id + order_id combinations in processed seller-order table.
recommended_action: No action required.

interpretation: Orders whose customer_id is absent from the customers table.
recommended_action: Investigate orphaned customer references before customer-level analysis.

interpretation: Order-item records whose seller_id is absent from the sellers table.
recommended_action: Investigate orphaned seller references before seller-level analysis.

interpretation: Negative item prices in raw order items.
recommended_action: Exclude or correct negative prices before monetary analysis.

interpretation: Negative freight values in raw order items.
recommended_action: Exclude or correct negative freight values before shipping analysis.

interpretation: Negative payment values in raw payments.
recommended_action: Review payment records before revenue analysis.

interpretation: Orders with zero total payment value.
recommended_action: Review voucher, unpaid, or not-yet-paid orders separately from paid-order analysis.

interpretation: Orders missing purchase dates.
recommended_action: Exclude from time-series analysis until purchase timestamps are validated.

interpretation: Orders missing estimated delivery dates.
recommended_action: Exclude from lateness modeling when estimated delivery is unavailable.

interpretation: Orders missing actual delivery dates, including canceled and in-transit orders.
recommended_action: Expected for non-delivered orders; investigate only when status indicates delivery.

interpretation: Actual delivery timestamp occurs before purchase timestamp.
recommended_action: Exclude or correct these records before delivery-duration analysis.

interpretation: Estimated delivery date occurs before purchase timestamp.
recommended_action: Review date parsing and exclude invalid records from lateness analysis.

interpretation: Approval timestamp occurs before purchase timestamp.
recommended_action: Review timestamp quality before approval-to-delivery analysis.

interpretation: Delivered orders lacking an actual delivery date.
recommended_action: Treat as undelivered in delivery-time metrics until delivery timestamps are resolved.

interpretation: Canceled or unavailable orders that still have an actual delivery date.
recommended_action: Review status logic before fulfillment performance reporting.

interpretation: Processed orders without corresponding item records.
recommended_action: Investigate item aggregation and order-item joins.

interpretation: Processed orders without corresponding payment records.
recommended_action: Investigate payment aggregation and unpaid-order handling.

interpretation: Orders where total_payment_value differs from total_item_price + total_freight_value by more than R$ 0.05.
recommended_action: Review separately; vouchers, discounts, interest, and split payments may explain differences and are not automatically errors.

interpretation: Payment values above the IQR upper fence (R$ 349.41).
recommended_action: Monitor high-value orders; do not delete without business review.

interpretation: Freight values above the IQR upper fence (R$ 39.39).
recommended_action: Review shipping cost outliers for data entry or long-distance shipments.

interpretation: Delivery durations above the IQR upper fence (29.15 days).
recommended_action: Use robust summaries or caps when reporting typical delivery times.

interpretation: Orders with missing or invalid seller_count.
recommended_action: Exclude from single- versus multi-seller comparisons until seller_count is validated.

interpretation: Orders fulfilled by more than one seller.
recommended_action: Interpret seller-level delivery metrics carefully because delivery outcomes are shared at order level.

interpretation: Missing purchase months in completed-order time series: 2016-11
recommended_action: Exclude or annotate missing months before trend comparisons.
